About UsDe Pijp Boutique Hotel is a premium, intimate design hotel located in the heart of Amsterdam's most vibrant neighborhood. Because we are a small boutique property with a close-knit team, our night staff plays a crucial role in maintaining high-end guest satisfaction, safety, and operational excellence while the city sleeps.We are looking for a reliable, responsible, and proactive Part-Time Night Receptionist who takes pride in absolute ownership of the property during the night.Position SummaryAs our Night Receptionist, you are the sole guardian of the hotel during the late-night and early-morning hours (typically from 00:00 to 08:00). • Experience: Previous experience in hotel night auditing, front desk operations, or security/hospitality service is highly preferred.

• Language Skills: Fluent in English (both written and spoken). Knowledge of Dutch or another European language is a great bonus.
• Legal Status: You must hold a valid EU passport or an unrestricted Dutch work permit with a valid BSN. We do not provide visa sponsorship.What We Offer
• A competitive part-time salary scaled to your experience in accordance with the Horeca-CAO, including applicable night-shift allowances.
• A safe, beautiful, and premium working environment in Amsterdam.
• Independence and trust to manage the property autonomously.
